notes: Hy-MT2-1.8B_int8.litertlm as uploaded to litert-community/Hy-MT2-1.8B on 2026-10-06 (Hub commit 9d24d91a): graph rewrite of the previous Hub file (KV-cache writes -> odml.cache_update, attention products -> odml.runtime_bmm, param_tensor input, broadcast mask add) plus one copied 16-token prefill signature; the weights are byte-identical to the previous file (sha256 529e6d378df5...), which this upload replaced. Built and measured by the litertlm-convert GPU graph re-ship lane (rounds 1-21). Mac gate of this file (round 19, litertlm-convert gpu_reship_work/results/ship_verify): 6/6 points — weights and every other section byte-identical to the previous file, tflite CPU outputs bit-identical, litert-lm CPU answers 9/9 byte-identical, GPU (WebGPU) fully delegated with fp32 activations 9/9 byte-identical; GPU fp16 (the default) final answers 6/8 against 6/8 without the 16-token signature. Galaxy S26 GPU gate (round 20, Session path, greedy): 3/4 questions, long prompt missed, the same points as the file without the 16-token signature on the same phone. Previous file on the same Mac in the same lock window (litert-lm 0.17.1, same flags): gpu p256 d256: decode 103.54 tok/s, prefill 2013.7 tok/s, TTFT 0.1368 s; gpu p16 d32: decode 97.55 tok/s, prefill 242.95 tok/s, TTFT 0.0761 s; cpu p256 d256: decode 32.16 tok/s, prefill 204.89 tok/s, TTFT 1.2806 s; cpu p16 d32: decode 17.85 tok/s, prefill 15.87 tok/s, TTFT 1.0648 s. Galaxy S26 rows: Google's prebuilt litert_lm_advanced_main (sha256 adac974b...) and libLiteRtOpenClAccelerator.so (d9dd64c3...) fetched on 2026-10-04 from storage.googleapis.com/litert/binaries/latest/android_arm64/litert_lm/ (object last-modified 2026-09-18; the binary carries the string 0.18.0 and prints no version line; LiteRT-LM main that day = 56c67f7d, the binary's own commit unconfirmed), so the snapshot axis is the digest token prebuilt-adac974b until the owner names it (DECISIONS #174(2)). Each figure is the median of the iterations of one process; per-iteration values are in metrics (iteration 1 starts cold at the full clock ceiling, later ones run under the phone's own thermal cap).
